name: Mercado do Sol
description: Discover unique artisanal crafts and semi-industrial objects at this charming open-air market, perfect for finding a special souvenir of your time in Porto.
longDescription:
The Mercado do Sol is a month-long open-air market held annually in Porto, presenting a curated selection of artisanal crafts and semi-industrial objects. This event provides a platform for local creators and small businesses to showcase their unique products, offering visitors an opportunity to acquire distinctive items. The market's focus is on handcrafted goods and thoughtfully designed objects, distinguishing it from typical souvenir shops.

Visitors to the Mercado do Sol can expect a relaxed atmosphere within the historic setting of Praça de Gomes Teixeira. The market is suitable for individuals interested in discovering original gifts or mementos of their visit to Porto. The outdoor venue allows for a pleasant browsing experience, with vendors displaying their wares across the square.

Entry to the Mercado do Sol is free for all visitors. The market is located in Praça de Gomes Teixeira, easily accessible by public transport. It is a short walk from Aliados metro station and numerous bus stops in the city centre. The event is family-friendly.
